quests.title: Rent Money, Pitt Street Mall
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I'm forty-five short on the Pitt Street Mall rent and the agent doesn't take stories. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Make it somewhere in Town Hall by school pick-up; I'm not fussy how. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Town Hall

quests.title: Seven a.m. At George Street
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. The site at George Street starts its jackhammer at after the footy on a Melbourne Cup day, which is illegal and loud. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Photograph it running and have a word with the Town Hall foreman. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: photograph the noise from George Street
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Race Four, Hyde Park
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. There's a horse in race four at peak hour that a bloke at Hyde Park swears by. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Town Hall and tell me if it came in. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: The the Archibald Fountain Sparky
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The sparky off the the Archibald Fountain job has owed me since the bathroom and drinks in Town Hall from six in the morning. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Forty will do and I'll write off the rest. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: find the sparky who owes for the Archibald Fountain
and get forty of it

quests.title: The the Archibald Fountain Complaint
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside the Archibald Fountain since Easter Saturday. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. One has Town Hall council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near the Archibald Fountain

quests.title: The Martin Place Tab
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Two chippies off the Martin Place job have run a tab in Town Hall since Monday. You will see what I mean the second you get there. They drove past at peak hour without looking in, so settle it in cash. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near Martin Place
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: The Angel Place Fence
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. My neighbour at Angel Place says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. I am aware how that sounds. Look at it Friday with Town Hall eyes and tell me the truth. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Angel Place
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: Closing Time at the Strand Arcade
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on the Strand Arcade since the pub shut. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. The Town Hall delivery's at eight at night, so get them up and show me the step empty. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off the Strand Arcade
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: Trolley Run, World Square
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. A Woolies trolley from World Square gets walked to the creek every the last Sunday of the month. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Find where it ends up in Town Hall and make the deposit back. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: find the trolley near World Square
photograph where it ended up
and earn the deposit back

quests.title: Bin Night, World Square
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Somebody moves the bins on World Square in front of my drive every Thursday night. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Town Hall knows who. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: photograph the bins at World Square
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: Meat Tray at the QVB
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The the QVB raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at lunchtime. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Find it in Town Hall and put it in the tin. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at the QVB

quests.title: The Town Hall steps Order
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. The Town Hall steps order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by knock-off. It started small, the way these things do. Find seventy in Town Hall and photograph the receipt. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: square the seventy for the Town Hall steps order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: Two From Town Hall steps
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Two of whatever's going near Town Hall steps, here, hot, before the footy at closing. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. It's Town Hall; I'm not asking for much. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: pick up two from near Town Hall steps
and get them here hot

quests.title: Cover at the QVB
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I've got nobody for the the QVB shift at lunchtime and a room full of Town Hall people who've paid. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Proof of George Street
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Nobody in Town Hall believes what George Street looks like at knock-off. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Get me a photo close enough that council can't say it's somewhere else. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: get a picture of George Street before they fix it

quests.title: The Martin Place Complaint
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside Martin Place since Monday. I am aware how that sounds. One has Town Hall council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near Martin Place

quests.title: Something From Angel Place
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The stall at Angel Place has run out and the customers keep coming. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Find something round Town Hall that'll do before the the change of shift rush. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: pick something up near Angel Place
bring it to the stall

quests.title: A Flat White From Angel Place
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I want a flat white from the place near Angel Place, not the one next to it. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Here by nine sharp, while it's still coffee and Town Hall still has some. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near Angel Place
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: Closing Time at World Square
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on World Square since the pub shut. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. The Town Hall delivery's at midnight, so get them up and show me the step empty. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off World Square
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: RBT on the light rail
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. There's a breath test set up on the light rail since the change of shift. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Town Hall without a conversation. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: get past the breath test on the light rail
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: The Length of Town Hall steps
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. I haven't walked Town Hall steps end to end since the light rail came to Town Hall. It started small, the way these things do. Do it Easter Saturday for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: walk the length of Town Hall steps
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Left It Near Town Hall steps
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I left something on the bench at Town Hall steps at school pick-up. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. By the time I got back to Town Hall it had walked, so look where I'd have dropped it. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: check the bench near Town Hall steps
photograph the bins behind it
tell me what you found

quests.title: Two From the QVB
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Two of whatever's going near the QVB, here, hot, before the footy at three in the morning. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. It's Town Hall; I'm not asking for much. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: pick up two from near the QVB
and get them here hot

quests.title: Probationary at the QVB
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. A young constable has been doing his first solo patrol round the QVB since Easter Saturday. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. He's decided Town Hall is his, so give him a story for the sergeant. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: lose the probationary constable near the QVB

quests.title: Trouble at Pitt Street Mall
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Two lads and their mate decided at school pick-up that Pitt Street Mall is theirs. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. The rest of Town Hall disagrees, so explain the disagreement. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: sort the pair near Pitt Street Mall
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: Staffy Near Hyde Park
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Hyde Park at eight at night. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Everyone in Town Hall has definitely seen it and can't say where. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near Hyde Park
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana
